findings.passage: Finally, we must hold criminals accountable. That includes mandatory minimum prison sentences for repeat gun offenders and serious penalties for straw purchasers who put weapons in the wrong hands. These are straightforward, common-sense measures with bipartisan support and potential to pass that would make our communities safer and reduce the risk of future violence.
findings.note: From his interim newsletter after the Annunciation shooting, about the special session plan. He backs mandatory minimum sentences for repeat gun offenders and serious penalties for straw purchasers. In the same letter he criticizes the Governor's proposals as hyper-partisan and not vetted in committee, without naming specific gun bills.
